subject: FACTORY paragraph
notes: Rule (cite.py --check 11.4.3 "Interface-name-1 shall be the name of an interface specified in the REPOSITORY paragraph of the containing class definition" -> OK §11.4.3 1)). Code: Build's CaptureImplements resolves each FACTORY IMPLEMENTS name through OoNameResolution.Resolve(Want.Interface) against the CLASS definition's REPOSITORY scope, COBOL0840 citing ISO §11.4.3 SR1. Probes: p1 - FPI defined in the group and in the PROGRAM's repository but NOT the class's -> COBOL0840 '(FACTORY): IMPLEMENTS FPI ... not declared in the REPOSITORY paragraph ... (ISO §11.4.3 SR1)'; p8 - IMPLEMENTS names a CLASS (FPC, in the class REPOSITORY) -> COBOL0840 'no such an interface' (both halves: 'an interface' and 'specified in the REPOSITORY'). Legal cases (p5/p6) accepted. No existing test exercises the FACTORY arm (OoClassTablePositionTests INTERFACES covers the OBJECT arm's 0840 only) -> test-ref empty (test-needed). Cosmetic only: the 0840 message reads 'no such an interface'. || Editions (adjudicator, verbatim): 2002, 2014, 2023 (OO - the FACTORY paragraph - is new in ISO/IEC 1989:2002; absent from 1985; Annex E of 2023 lists no change to §11.4)
